articleTitle: 4 Hip Stretches That Actually Improve Cross-Legged Sitting
imageHeadline: Can't sit cross-legged? Your hips need these 4 stretches
imageSubtext: Target the muscle groups that actually limit hip mobility
pinTitle: 4 Hip Stretches That Actually Improve Cross-Legged Sitting | Evidence-Based Guide
pinDescription: Limited hip mobility from tight adductors, hip flexors, and external rotators makes cross-legged sitting uncomfortable. These four stretches target the real restrictions—butterfly, 90/90, low lunge, and pigeon—with guidance on frequency and what to expect over time.
